targets.title: Communicating about others: Motivations and consequences of race-based impressions.
targets.evidence_quote: I attempted to replicate two other findings from Biernat and Sesko (2013): the finding that as IMS decreased, communications about the target (subjective ratings) were more positive and the finding that as IMS decreased, memory of the target’s GPA was lower.
targets.outcome_quote: This is inconsistent with Biernat and Sesko’s finding that as communication positivity (i.e., subjective ratings) increased, anti-Black attitudes increased at low levels of IMS. If anything, as communication positivity increased, anti-Black attitudes decreased at low levels of IMS.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Focal effect fails in both stages; additional tested effects are also described as inconsistent with the original.

reasoning: Full final report dated November 30, 2020, with Laura Smalarz identified as replication team. Assigned title describes the same report; supplied 2025 year is not its report date.
